commands:
git checkout -b fix/issue-7-login-loop && git add src/auth.js && git commit -m "Fix infinite recursion in refresh() when session is expired

refresh() called itself forever on an expired session, freezing the
page. It now fetches a fresh session via fetchSession().

Fixes #7" && git push -u origin fix/issue-7-login-loop

gh pr create --title "Fix login loop when session cookie expires (#7)" --body "## Problem
After the session cookie expires, the page freezes: \`refresh()\` in \`src/auth.js\` recursed into itself forever on an expired session.

## Fix
- \`refresh()\` now returns \`fetchSession()\` instead of recursing
- Added \`fetchSession()\`, which returns a fresh, valid session

## Test
\`\`\`
refresh({expired:true})  -> {expired:false}
refresh({expired:false}) -> session unchanged
\`\`\`

Fixes #7"

starbridge ask \
  --question 'Issue #7 is fixed in PR #14 — merge it?' \
  --context 'refresh() no longer recurses on an expired session; it fetches a fresh one via fetchSession(). One-line fix plus a 3-line helper, tested locally.
Merge: closes the login-loop issue now.
Review first: the diff and tests are on the PR.' \
  --option 'Merge PR #14' --option 'I will review it myself' \
  --link https://github.com/acme/notes/pull/14
turns.final: The PR is up. The owner reviews and merges every PR himself, so I need to reach him via starbridge before ending my turn:
